text:
Courtney: Quick sync — launching Wave F preview cohort next week. Need enrollment + enablement + feedback plan. Two seats/account. Priority accounts: MapleHealth (high renewal risk), NovaWorks (advocate).

Priya: Got it. I can handle invites + intake form. Which time windows should we propose? Mon/Wed 9–11am PT preferred from previous cohorts.

Devon: I can run the integrations walkthroughs Wed 10:30 PT. Will prepare a 20m demo + 10m Q&A and sample prompt set.

Alana: I'll own account health checks — planning 15-min 1:1s one week after kickoff. Heads up: MapleHealth currently a ~40% renewal risk due to SSO delay.

Courtney: Thanks. Feedback loop: 48h pulse form (3 quick Qs) + shared doc for qualitative notes. Priya — can you spin up the form? Use this snippet: ```questions:
- How easy was onboarding (1-5)
- What broke / blockers?
- Likelihood to recommend (1-5)```

Priya: Yep creating the form now and will post link here. I'll also create #preview-wave-f channel and pin the form.

Devon: Suggest we record sessions + enable transcript (redact PII). I'll pre-upload a small perf baseline for the demo (token/sample workloads).

Alana: For MapleHealth I'm escalating the SSO ticket to eng; just pinged @eng-sre. I'll also add a renewal flag and note in Salesforce.

Courtney: :thumbsup: Can someone volunteer to synthesize feedback within 72h and tag any model/regression issues so Research can triage? We want an initial digest before next week.

Priya: I can synthesize week-1 feedback. Plan: short rubric per report — severity / reproducible / blocker / suggested owner.

Devon: I'll log perf/latency anomalies in infra tracker with request ids. Example log we should capture in the report: ```request_id=abc123 latency_ms=480 model=redwood-alpha quant=8bit```

DeployBot: Calendar invite created: "Wave F kickoff" Tue 2026-04-07 10:00 PT — attendees: MapleHealth (2), NovaWorks (3), Redwood CS team. Link: https://cal.link/abc

Courtney: Perfect. Action items recap: Priya — form + channel + synth for week 1; Devon — demo + record + perf baseline; Alana — 1:1s + SFDC renewal notes + escalate SSO; Courtney — open eng-platform ticket for usage dashboards post-demo. Ping me if MapleHealth SSO not cleared by Mon.

Alana: Noted. I'll call MapleHealth CSM this afternoon.

Priya: :raised_hands: Form posted and pinned in #preview-wave-f: https://forms.redwood/example — also added an intake CSV template.

Devon: One small ask — can ops surface account-level usage dashboards within 24h after each session so we can correlate behavior?

Courtney: I'll file the eng-platform ticket and tag ops. Priya, can you follow up there after you post the synthesis?

Priya: Yep. I'll follow up and update the channel when dashboard access is available.

Courtney: Thanks all — let's keep notes concise in the channel, and call out anything blocking so we can escalate quickly. :rocket:
